widths.note: southern part, from about y 1040 to Kirby Alley

bends.note: west line steps out about 63 px (18 ft); centreline shifts from about x 2112 to x 2083 as the alley widens from 10' to 25'

ends.note: ends at the unnamed 12' north-south alley (2nd to Front); does not reach Sycamore
dead end at the rear of 208 E. Front; railroad sidings and platform alongside

notes: Main on the west, Sycamore on the east; south of E. Front is the Public Landing, so Sycamore ends at Front (T) and Main continues south with only its west line drawn (centre taken from the water pipe and 66' width). Water Street (printed WATER ST. here, E. WATER on sheets 101-102) and Giffin end at Main from the west; Giffin's north line only is drawn here (sloping up to the east at about -0.17); the centre is taken 69 px south of it (40' street, per sheet 102) and extended to Main's centreline. Produce Alley crosses E. 2nd: the alley north of 2nd (sheet 113, not named here) is centred about x 2094, the Produce Alley mouth about x 2112, so the crossing point is averaged. Kirby Alley (printed KIRBY ALLEY) runs east from Main (a building marked WALL 1ST ONLY sits over its Main Street mouth) past Barr Alley and Produce Alley to the unnamed alley. Yeatman (printed YEATMAN, east of Sycamore) ends at Sycamore from the east; it does not line up with Kirby Alley, which stops short of Sycamore. Barr Alley (printed BARR AL.) runs south from Kirby Alley and dead-ends behind the Front Street lots. The unnamed N-S alley has 12 printed at both mouths; ALLEY, IRON CL'D and BRICK are printed along it.
